# OpenAI Python SDK Releases — captured 2026-06-14
# (Node SDK tracked in openai_node_changelog.txt — latest v6.42.0, June 3)

## Latest Releases

**v2.41.1** (June 10, 2026)
- Build-system change only ("Remove scheduled release workflow trigger"). No API/feature change. Not reportable.

**v2.41.0** (June 3, 2026)
- responses.moderation and chat_completions.moderation capabilities. (matched by Node v6.42.0)

**v2.40.0** (June 1, 2026)
- Add Amazon Bedrock Responses support (point Responses API at bedrock-mantle OpenAI-compatible endpoint, AWS-managed auth); set Bedrock API keys directly on client.

**v2.39.0** (June 1, 2026)
- Workload identity in audit logs; additional tools in responses; made ActionSearch.query optional.

**v2.38.0** (May 21, 2026) - General API updates.
**v2.37.0** (May 15, 2026) - service_tier on responses compact; eager pydantic iterator validation.
**v2.36.0** (May 7, 2026) - Realtime 2 API implementation.
**v2.35.0** (May 6, 2026) - Updated image generation API; removed legacy Python CLI.
**v2.34.0** (May 4, 2026) - external_key_id on projects; Admin API Keys per endpoint; header config via env vars.
**v2.33.0** (April 28, 2026) - API updates; fixed prompt_cache_retention enum.
**v2.32.0** (April 15, 2026) - detail field on InputFileContent; websocket reconnection support.

Updated: 2026-06-14 — Latest v2.41.1 (June 10) is a build-system change only; v2.41.0 (June 3) feature set unchanged and already reported. No net-new coverage surface.
